title: Kiritani Haruka — Donuts And Memories〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: Red Brick Center - Building 1, 1st Floor

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Thank you for shaking my hand, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Me too, Haruka! I want a handshake too!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Teacher
rows.Line:
Shhh! Don't shout like that.
That'll trouble the other customers, and Ms. Kiritani is in the middle of hide and seek, remember?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line:
Oh! That's right...
Sorry, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. Thanks to all of your help, I haven't been found yet.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Teacher
rows.Line: So sorry for all of the trouble, but thank you very much for going along with the kids' wishes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's alright. I'm happy to do this much.
Also, is that everyone?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line:
Oh, wait Haruka!
Hey, you sure you're okay not shaking her hand?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Um... I don't really know about her, so...

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line:
What?! You don't know Haruka?
Even though “Rainbow Parameters” and a bunch of other ASRUN songs are always playing during lunch?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Huh? Did you sing those songs, Miss?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, yes, I did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm in a group called MORE MORE JUMP! now and we're all singing our hardest.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: I didn't know that...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Um, actually... Can I shake your hand?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Yay...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: But what are you doing here, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: She said she's playing hide and seek. So it's probably for TV, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I'm actually on a field trip right now.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Huh? You're on a field trip too? So is that girl you were with before your friend?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, she is. We're in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Really? Are you close?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, we're very close. We have lunch together a lot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hoshino and Tenma didn't care that I was an ex-idol and called out to me...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Morning, Haruka!
Are you looking for something? What happened?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Y-Yes... I dropped something important.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh dear! Come on, we have to find it quickly!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What did you drop?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're going to help me look?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was so happy they did that, and it really changed my life...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: So those classmates are really important to you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm very grateful that we ended up in the same class and became friends.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Hehehe. That's like the same as us! We also became friends after we got put in the same class!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, everyone. Don't forget to say “thank you” to Ms. Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Teacher
rows.Line: Once again, thank you so very much for your time.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm going to remember this forever! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.
